family_directives.objective: Investigate ranking-objective formulations in depth through the stable trainable scaffold. Select pointwise, bpr, or listwise and adapt only typed configuration parameters from prior confidence intervals and training diagnostics. Prefer a targeted refinement of promising evidence or a falsifying alternative to a failed hypothesis; do not repeat a prior design.
family_directives.temporal_history: Investigate strictly past user-history modeling in depth through the stable trainable scaffold. Select temporal_history and adapt typed history decay, shrinkage, residual scale, capacity, regularization, and optimization parameters from prior confidence intervals and training diagnostics. Prefer a targeted refinement of promising evidence or a falsifying alternative to a failed hypothesis; do not repeat a prior design.
